name: .411 Cal-326gr Stone Hammer®
note: Minimum required twist rate for Dangerous Game hunting is 1-15″ or faster. Minimum required twist rate for Big Game hunting is 1-18″ or faster. Recommended use: Big Game and Dangerous Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This pure copper hunting bullet was designed with the 405 Winchester in mind. It will feed well in the lever guns as well as work in the single shots and bolt rifles. The 405 Winchester should have no trouble getting these to about 2200 fps for a hard hitting do all combination."
